profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MDisrupt
profile.summary: Versatile Software Engineer with more than 15 years experience in designing, developing and leading projects that impact business outcomes.  I bring strong mentorship skills and a track record of taking vision strategy from leadership to build new and existing product lines.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Owner of the GLG Council Member user experience (Product Design/UX).  Implemented highly usable prototype designs for the entire Omni Channel experience. (Sketch, Figma, Framer X, React.js, CSS, SQL)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead engineer for consultation transcripts. Since product release, transcripts have grown to 3.2M in revenue for 2018.  6.8% of all GLG phone consultations are transcribed per month. (Node.js, Express.js, Bash, Sass, Angular.js, MSSQL)

•	Implemented GLG Events product refresh and UI re-write that improved event attendance conversion by 5% (statistically significant). Re-designed the entire event product and improved the user experience to help our customers seamlessly book and cancel events. (Node.js, Express, MSSQL, Angular.js, Sass/CSS, Python, Jupyter Notebook)

•	Launched the GO platform that allow GLG clients from more than 1,400 companies to review and manage their GLG projects.  The GO platform allows scheduling, media access for transcripts/recordings, and review billing history and records. (Node.js, MSSQL, Angular.js, SASS/CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Primarily focused on UI design and implementation of Spacecraft’s web publishing platform. (Node.js, JavaScript, SASS/CSS, HTML 5)

•	Created a scheduling component with a customizable monthly calendar interface that was successfully integrated into the product’s publishing platform. (Node.js, JavaScript, HTML 5, Stylus/CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built the front-end to a single-page application (SPA) called Writer. The Writer app was the flagship product for DemandStudios.com that allowed thousands of freelance writers to create and submit articles for high trafficking websites that include eHow.com, LiveStrong.com, USAToday.com and SFGate.com. (Backbone.js, Underscore.js, jQuery, CSS)

•	Constructed user interfaces for data visualization for product managers, engineers and executive management to monitor article generation and title assignments for freelance writers. (Tornado web server, Python, JavaScript, CSS)

•	Developed and improved existing product functionality for Demand Media’s Social Media Platform that includes Forums, Blogs, Personas. (ASP.NET/C#, JavaScript, XHTML and CSS)

•	Designed and developed a reporting tool that automates the process of collecting page view counts and API usage for our social media platform.  Tool was built for Business Intelligence for getting a better understanding of the overall usage of our social media toolset.  (Python)

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Was part of the Management Information Group (MIG) that focused on shipping Microsoft Diagnostics and Recovery Toolset (MSDaRT). MSDaRT is a complete suite of powerful, versatile tools that allow you to repair unbootable or locked-out systems, restore lost data, and diagnose system and network issues. Created test plans and test cases according to requirements to verify features and product stability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Scopes of responsibility include developing test tools, writing test cases, and executing regression tests for the Advance Process Control (APC) Team. APC applications are the underlying software that drives the photolithography process during wafer fabrication.

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description:
(EA relocated our Development Studio to California) Daily tasks consist of creating and maintaining and Automation Framework using .NET/C# and the Unreal 3D Game Engine (UnrealEngine2) for the massively multiplayer online game "Ultima X:
Odyssey" (UXO).

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Provided contractual Quality Assurance (QA) services for Microsoft Games Studio - Digital Anvil. QA tasks include configuration testing, test plan development, technical documentation, Xbox Certification and Windows XP Logo Certification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with telecom protocols to develop software utilizing the C programming language and C shell scripting on UNIX and Sun Solaris operating systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained WSMR Real-Time system code using C, Fortran, and Perl to collect data from various radar sensors. Conceptualized and implemented user interfaces with Sun's Workshop Visual (Forte), an Xmotif toolkit, for Operational Handlers that conduct missile launches.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at El Paso
